name: Rosie Lockwood
title: Keywarden
description: A cheerful halfling woman with nimble fingers and a ring of intricate keys hanging from her belt. Rosie runs the communal storage burrows with the same care she gives her prize-winning garden.

greeting.first_time: Oh hello there, dearie! Welcome to Millhaven! I'm Rosie Lockwood, Keywarden of the Burrowlock. Come to store something safe, have you?
greeting.returning: Back again! Your burrow's just as you left it, dear.
greeting.native_race: Good to see you, neighbor! Your family burrow is always open.

about_service.text: Every family in Millhaven has a storage burrow beneath their home—been that way for generations! Halflings and gnomes who live here use them freely, of course. But if you're from out of town, I'll need to carve you a new lock and key. Can't be too careful, you know, though I'm sure you're perfectly trustworthy!

ask_about_key.text: Oh, it's no fee really — more a matter of fittings. Every burrow needs its own brass lock, and a pair of candles so you can see what you're reaching for. Bring me a lock and two candles, and ten gold for the cutting of the key, and I'll have your burrow fitted by supper.

pay_key_fee.text: Lovely. Let me just... there. Your key, and the lock's twin stays with me on the ring. Mind, it's not really a different burrow to the others — all us keywardens' rings open onto the same deep cellar. Old magic, that. Your things'll be waiting wherever you find one of us.
pay_key_fee.success: Rosie fitted your lock at the Burrowlock. You may store items here.
pay_key_fee.failure: I'd need a lock, two candles and ten gold to fit your burrow, dear.

use_storage.text: Right this way! Watch your head on the doorframe, dear — we halflings don't build for tall folk! And don't fret about which burrow is yours. Every keywarden's ring opens the same deep cellar. Leave your bundle with me and Rosie's cousin in the swamp will hand it straight back.

maybe_later.text: No rush at all, dear! I'm here every day. Do stop by the market before you go—Farmer Took has the loveliest turnips!

goodbye.text: Safe travels, dear! Come back anytime—there's always a warm meal and a friendly face in Millhaven!

claim_birthright.text: Oh, you're a Millhaven soul! No lock to buy, no key to cut — your family's burrow has been on my ring since before you were knee-high. Here. It's always been yours, dear.
claim_birthright.success: Rosie handed over your family's burrow key. It was always yours.
claim_birthright.failure: There seems to be some irregularity. Speak with me again.

homeward_stone.text: Oh, a Homeward Stone! Every Millhaven child gets one on their key ring, it brings you back to the waystone on the green, once a week, like clockwork. Visitors can have one too, once I know you're the sort who helps. And I could always use a hand.

options.label: [Millhaven-born] I never got a stone for my key ring.

homeward_gift.text: Well, that won't do at all! Here, one for your ring. Free the first time, mind. After that I have to charge, the stones aren't free to attune.

homeward_shop.text: Here they are, each one attuned to our waystone on the green. Only one per pocket, dear.
